guide.title: Guide
guide.how_1: Search a package in the winget community repository and add it to a deployment.
guide.how_2: The module writes one GPO per deployment into Active Directory, with a scheduled task per package that runs as SYSTEM.
guide.how_3: The GPO is linked to the whole domain or to organizational units. Every computer below applies it, and every later change, at its next policy refresh: at start-up, about every 90 minutes, or with gpupdate.
guide.how_4: At the next scheduled time the task runs winget on the computer: it installs or updates the package from the vendor's download, checked against the hash in the repository. A start time that already passed is not caught up.
guide.how_5: "Run now" adds a one-time task: every computer runs the packages once at its next policy refresh, independent of the schedule.
guide.account_help: The module writes GPOs with a service account of its own. It must not be a domain admin; it needs exactly these rights:
guide.right_group: Member of Group Policy Creator Owners (write access to the Policies folder in SYSVOL)
guide.right_create: Delegated right to create GPO objects in CN=Policies (Samba does not give it to the group above)
guide.right_link: Delegated right to write gPLink and gPOptions where GPOs are linked (domain root or organizational units)
guide.account_ok_desc: {user} has all rights the module needs.
guide.auto_help: For a domain of this cluster the module creates the account itself under {settings}, with domain admin credentials that are used once and not stored. The account gets a random password only the module knows.
guide.auto_no_domain: No Active Directory domain of this cluster found: use the commands below on the domain controller.
guide.auto_done_desc: {user} was set up and stored in the settings.
guide.manual_help: On the node of the domain controller (the values of the selected domain are filled in):
guide.manual_ou: Step 6 covers all organizational units of the domain, also ones created later. Then enter the account and its password under {settings}.
guide.cmd_create: Create the account (asks for the password) and keep the password from expiring.
guide.cmd_sid: Get the SID of the account (for the following commands).
guide.clients_1: Windows 10 or 11 joined to the domain
guide.clients_2: App Installer (winget) from the Microsoft Store; version 1.21 as shipped with some images is too old: update it or install it from github.com/microsoft/winget-cli.
guide.clients_3: Internet access to the vendor downloads
guide.error_admin_bind_failed: The domain admin could not log in
guide.error_admin_not_allowed: This account may not create users or change permissions
guide.error_setup_failed: Setting up the account failed, see the module log
guide.error_dc_not_resolved: No domain controller known for this domain
guide.delivery_sysvol: The script lies in the GPO folder in SYSVOL; the task starts it from there (\\domain\SysVol\...). Readable in the GPO and easy to check, but the computer must reach SYSVOL when the task runs.
guide.delivery_embedded: The script is part of the task's command line (-EncodedCommand). The task needs nothing but itself at run time, e.g. on a laptop outside the office; the script is not readable in plain text in the GPO.
guide.delivery_choice: Both are tested; the default for new deployments is set under {settings}.
guide.link_domain: The GPO applies to every computer of the domain.
guide.link_ou: The GPO applies only to computers in this organizational unit and the ones below it. The Domain Controllers unit is not offered: on NS8 the domain controllers are Samba servers, not Windows computers.
guide.link_computers: New computers are placed in the Computers container, which is not an organizational unit: they only get deployments linked to the whole domain until they are moved into an organizational unit. When linking, the module can create a missing OU empty; computers are moved into it with an AD tool (e.g. RSAT or LDAP Admin).
guide.mode_upgrade: Updates the package on computers where it is installed; on the others nothing happens.
guide.mode_install: Installs the package where it is missing and updates it where it is installed.
guide.mode_msi: Prefer MSI packages (e.g. Google.Chrome instead of Google.Chrome.EXE): some EXE installers wait for a desktop when they run as SYSTEM and hang until the run is stopped after two hours.
guide.how_6: This server only reads the index and writes the GPO; the computers download the software themselves.
guide.cmd_gpo: Give the right to create GPOs.
guide.cmd_link: Give the right to link GPOs to the domain (gPLink, gPOptions).
guide.clients_4: No VC++ redistributable needed: the script puts the runtime of winget on its search path.
guide.cmd_link_ous: Give the right to link GPOs to organizational units (inherited, also for OUs created later).
guide.cmd_create_ou: Optional: give the right to create empty organizational units (when linking a new OU).
